description: Search or list legislators (GET /v1/legislators) by jurisdiction, chamber, party, district, or name. This is how you turn a name into the people_id that get_legislator needs. Filters combine with AND.

state.description: 2-letter postal code (e.g. FL), DC, or US for Congress.
